description: Join a Jitsi Meet session in the room 'TrainingSession' as 'Training Lead'. Locate and open the 'Keyboard shortcuts' help overlay (often found in the 'More actions' menu or by pressing '?'). Take a screenshot of the visible Shortcuts overlay and save it to '/home/ga/shortcuts_evidence.png'. Then, create a text file at '/home/ga/shortcuts_reference.txt' listing the keys and descriptions for these three actions: 1. Mute/Unmute Microphone, 2. Start/Stop Camera, 3. Show/Hide Filmstrip. The file format should be '[Key] - [Description]'.
